payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how clusters were extracted using k-means clustering on word embeddings, particularly with GloVe vectors trained on Wikipedia articles and initialized with k-means++.

claims.text: Clusters were extracted using k-means clustering on word embeddings, initialized with k-means++ and run for 300 iterations.
The embeddings used for clustering were GloVe vectors trained on Wikipedia articles, which were combined with in-domain data for better performance.
The clustering process involved repeating the experiment with different seed initializations to minimize cluster inertia.
